contexts.text: I will make thy suns (windows) of rubies () = intellectual truths from charity; and therefore they are likened to a ruby.
Auras sparkling as it were with rubies and carbuncles. HH 382.
He was girt with a hand which as it were flamed and shone with rubies and sapphires.
A golden girdle, upon which were three precious stones: two sapphires at the sides, and a ruby in the middle.
She wore a necklace of rubies...
He wore a tiara studded on the right side with some rubies.
A cloud which sparkled like a carbuncle from the flame of the sun.

A sardius also is mentioned (), because by this stone is signified good... It is this stone which is called pyropus, which, as it shines as if from fire, by both is signified the translucence of truth from good.
I will make thy suns of rubies, and thy gates in stones of carbuncle = goods coruscating from the fire of love (and truths resplendent from good). A ruby = coruscation as from fire. AE 717:5.
